```{r include=FALSE}
library(readr)

Sys.setenv(lang = "en_US")
```


```{r}
setwd('C:/Users/nchu/Desktop/DATA/merged_data')
my_reg_data <- read_parquet('updated_first_stage_data.parquet')

setwd('C:/Users/nchu/Desktop/DATA/merged_data')
renewable_shock_series <- read_parquet(
              'renewable_shock_series.parquet')


# add the information from the renewable shock series 

first_stage_combined <- merge(my_reg_data, renewable_shock_series,
  by= c('datetime', 'gen_tot'))


first_stage_combined <-first_stage_combined %>% 
  select("price", 'price_diff', "delivery_date", "log_price_diff", 'creneau', 'datetime' , "uncertainty_shock" ,"uncertainty_shock_relative" , 'auction_before', "real_unavailability_share",     "theoretical_unavailability_share", "centrale_unavailability_share",  'gen_tot' ,
"idcode") %>% 
  rename(renew_gen_shock = uncertainty_shock,
         renew_gen_rel_shock = uncertainty_shock_relative) %>% 
  mutate(gen_tot = gen_tot/1000)

first_stage_combined_5 <- first_stage_combined %>% 
    filter(auction_before == 5)


head(first_stage_combined,5)
# colnames(first_stage_combined)
```


Complete models that include plant unavailabilities as well as the renewable based instrument


```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_basic <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability_share + renew_gen_rel_shock + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_combined)
# use controls
# put a dummy for the number of the auction
# put a dummy for the creneau
m_date <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability_share+ renew_gen_rel_shock + gen_tot + factor(delivery_date) ,
  data= first_stage_combined)

# dummy for creneau

m_creneau <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability_share+ renew_gen_rel_shock + gen_tot + factor(creneau) ,
  data= first_stage_combined)

# warning cannot put a dummy for date + creneau + auction
# full determination, no variation
m_control <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ real_unavailability_share+ renew_gen_rel_shock + gen_tot + factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_combined)

```

Interpretation
for the basic model,
for a given unavailability of 1 percentage point,
the electricity price increases by 0.9 %



```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic, m_date, m_creneau, m_control, 
    type = "html",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Date FE", "Timeslot FE", 'Timeslot + Auction FE'),
    keep = c('Constant','real_unavailability_share', 'renew_gen_rel_shock', 'gen_tot')
 )
```
